hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && input=$(cat); if printf "%s" "$input" | jq -e ".stop_hook_active == true" >/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; git status --porcelain | grep -qE "\.(ts|tsx|mjs)$" || exit 0; out=$(yarn -s typecheck 2>&1) || { printf "Typecheck en échec, corrige avant de terminer :\n%s\n" "$(printf "%s" "$out" | head -40)" >&2; exit 2; }
